_note: Team mapping from MASCO 2020 to ISCO-08 unit groups, drafted from role descriptions and ISCO titles; not an official correspondence table. To be reviewed by the team.

2524-02.note: Analyses and models data to support decisions; closest ISCO-08 unit is statisticians.

3512-05.note: Supports database upkeep and retrieval at technician level; closest to ICT user support technicians (weak fit).

2543-07.note: Studies operations, processes and supply chains for improvement; fits management and organization analysts.

3513-01.note: Installs and troubleshoots network infrastructure; direct fit with computer network and systems technicians.

2423-09.note: Designs online learning programmes and modules; closest to education methods (instructional design) specialists.

2531-04.note: Protects systems and networks from threats; ISCO-08 puts IT security specialists in database and network professionals NEC.

3131-07.note: Assembles, tests and services solar PV equipment; closest to electrical engineering technicians (weak fit).

2513-01.note: Designs and builds websites and web applications; direct fit with web and multimedia developers.

2543-03.note: Designs user interfaces and digital experiences; closest to graphic and multimedia designers.

2541-09.note: Researches and writes content for digital platforms; closest to authors and related writers.

3313-04.note: Inspects and assesses building energy use as a technician; closest to physical and engineering science technicians NEC (not ISCO 3313, which is accounting).

2141-13.note: Designs renewable energy systems; closest to engineering professionals NEC.

2269-01.note: Collects and analyses health data and reports; closest to statisticians (alternative: 2421; weak fit).

3514-01.note: Maintains and supports websites and web servers; direct fit with web technicians.

2511-08.note: Coordinates digital change and business requirements; closest to systems analysts (alternative: 2421; weak fit).

2411-01.note: Keeps and prepares financial records and statements; direct fit with accountants.

2411-02.note: Advises on tax rules and prepares returns; closest to accountants (ISCO-08 has no separate tax unit).

2411-05.note: Examines financial records and controls; closest to accountants (auditors are in ISCO 2411).

3313-02.note: Supports audits by checking records and gathering evidence; closest to accounting associate professionals.

3313-03.note: Records transactions and prepares accounts at technician level; direct fit with accounting associate professionals.
